exposure: Doppler measurements of placental and fetal hemodynamics
outcome: pulsatility indices of uterine and umbilical arteries
outflow velocities of the great arteries
cohort: 160 pregnant women with uncomplicated singleton pregnancies at >41 weeks gestation
finding: Doppler parameters of placental and fetal central and peripheral hemodynamics did not differ prior to induction of labor in prolonged pregnancies with favorable and unfavorable outcomes, suggesting limited value in predicting adverse outcomes.
